nome_jp: 閃光龍覇 デコローズ
testo:
Blocker
Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature, you may choose one of your opponent's creatures and put it into its owner's hyperspatial zone.
■ Your opponent can't put creatures from their hyperspatial zone and they can't put creatures that have the same name as a card in their hyperspatial zone.
■ When this creature leaves, choose one of your opponent's creatures that has the lowest cost in your opponent's hyperspatial zone. Your opponent may put it.
testo_jp:
Blocker
Double Breaker
■ このクリーチャーが出た時、相手のクリーチャーを1体選び、持ち主の超次元ゾーンに置いてもよい。
■ 相手は自身の超次元ゾーンからクリーチャーを出せず、自身の超次元ゾーンにあるクリーチャーと同じ名前のクリーチャーを出せない。
■ このクリーチャーが離れた時、相手の超次元ゾーンにある、コストが一番小さいクリーチャーを1体選ぶ。相手はそれを出してもよい。
